user.title: Adax heater (local, IP + token)
user.description: Address and access token of one heater, as stored by `adax-direct pair` (see the README). The heater must already be on your Wi-Fi.

data.host: IP address or host (host:port for a non-standard port)
data.name: Name (e.g. Living room)

error.cannot_connect: The heater did not answer a status request with this address and token.

data.duty_base: Duty at target (0-1, share of time on when room = target)
data.idle_offset_k: Idle offset (K, -5 to 5; 0 = off): added to the reading once the heater has not heated for the settle time
data.settle_min: Settle time (min, 0-180) after the heater last heated

error.cannot_connect: The heater did not answer a status request with this address and token.
